message.content:
The existing search confirms the relevant Kipchoge Wikipedia entry, but not the Moon’s minimum perigee. I’m retrieving the Moon page data, then I’ll calculate using Kipchoge’s official record pace and round to the nearest 1000 hours.
```python
moon_wiki = await wikipedia_search("Moon minimum perigee", max_results=5)
print(moon_wiki)
```

The Moon search needs the exact page text rather than just the result snippet, so I’m fetching the Wikipedia page directly.
```python
moon_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon", max_chars=20000)
print(moon_page)
```
Using the Wikipedia figures—minimum perigee 356400 km and Kipchoge’s official marathon world record of 2:01:09—I’m checking the exact hours before rounding.
17000
